overlays.name: TailscaleWebsiteDNS
overlays.reason: Preserve the four existing exact-host proxy-DNS exceptions; this resolver selector is narrower than the website routing overlay.

overlays.name: TailscaleProxy
overlays.reason: Preserve the common website, account and log exact-host exceptions without proxying the complete control namespace.

overlays.name: TailscaleCampusProxy
overlays.reason: Campus alternative: common website exceptions plus only the archived blocked relay hosts and two-character relay wildcard.

overlays.name: TailscaleNetwork
overlays.reason: Portable MagicDNS namespace only; individual tailnets, peers and application bypass settings remain private.

overlays.name: TailscaleNetworkIP
overlays.reason: Standard Tailscale address allocations, without peer addresses or private subnet-router routes; never initiate resolution.

overlays.name: TailscaleControl
overlays.reason: Control and relay fallback after the selected exact-host website/relay exceptions; process-level transport exemptions remain private.

overlays.name: CloudflareTunnel
overlays.reason: Preserve the tunnel transport namespace, not arbitrary Cloudflare sites or private tunnel hostnames.

overlays.name: CloudflareTunnelIP
overlays.reason: Preserve all three archived public prefix expressions only on destination port 7844, including the equivalent masked IPv6 spelling; no general Cloudflare IP bypass.

overlays.name: WindowsReject
overlays.reason: Optional Windows gateway rejection selector; binding it to rejection and restricting gateway clients are private integration decisions.

overlays.name: WindowsGateway
overlays.reason: Archived Windows gateway domain controls only, without expanding them to all Microsoft or connectivity-test traffic.

overlays.name: WindowsGatewayPorts
overlays.reason: Archived UDP-only time-service exception and protocol-independent delivery-optimization port; retain per-client guards privately.

overlays.name: CampusNetwork
overlays.reason: Derive the institutional namespace from PKU, including future reviewed PKU additions; suitable for explicit campus DNS/real-IP integration.

overlays.name: CampusServices
overlays.reason: Derive PKU, Academic and reviewed campus service families for physical campus egress after Reject. The archived campus domain set has no remaining residuals.

overlays.name: CampusExtraIP
overlays.reason: The single owner-approved campus destination, separate from resolving PKUIP so an early raw-address exception cannot bypass the domain stage for every campus range.

overlays.name: CampusNetworkIP
overlays.reason: Derive PKU address ranges plus one explicitly owner-approved campus destination; all IP leaves use no-resolve.

overlays.name: UKAI
overlays.reason: Preserve the existing UK profile's 30 inline AI selectors, in order and without policies; retain ModelDownloadCDN and AI before this overlay and AIIP after it.
